title: Shareshian–Wachs elementary positivity for chromatic quasisymmetric functions
exact_target: For every natural unit interval graph G on its natural labels, does its chromatic quasisymmetric function $chi_G(X;q)$ have every coefficient in the elementary symmetric-function basis in N[q]?
